task_name: O(1) Circuit Repetition & Direct AbstractCircuit Ingestion

optimizations: Optimized Circuit.__mul__ and Circuit.__rmul__ to directly construct repeated circuits using _from_moments(self._moments * rep, tags=self.tags), with O(1) empty circuit on rep<=0 and copy() on rep==1
Added direct fast ingestion path for single AbstractCircuit instances in Circuit.__init__ bypassing flatten_to_ops_or_moments and moment validation
